scope: Dripping Springs, Texas; public stay, event, venue and contact pages were reviewed.

metrics.label: Required event-inquiry questions
metrics.context: Visible labels counted: first/last name separately; the prior-visit yes/no choice counted once.

metrics.label: Wedding venue options presented
metrics.context: Five distinct options on the wedding venue page; capacities vary by layout.

observations.title: Test a lighter first inquiry
observations.observed: The event form marks 14 questions required, including budget, room count, referral source and booking urgency.
observations.improvement: Test an initial step for contact details, event type, approximate date and guest count. Collect planning details later; compare completion and lead quality.

observations.title: Make venue comparison easier
observations.observed: Five venue sections provide capacity and setting information; their named inquiry links lead to the same contact page.
observations.improvement: Test a compact comparison by guest count and indoor/outdoor setting, carrying the selected venue into the inquiry. Current abandonment was not measured.

limitations: Counts concern visible required labels and published venue options. No form was submitted or completed-booking performance measured.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
